name: Amanda Bartz
message:
Rest now, sweet boy. 🐾 We feel so lucky to have gotten to know you and spend time with you, especially these last few weeks. You were such a special boy, and our hearts are broken and absolutely break for your family. I hope you know just how loved you were, Tango. Sending all the love and you'll be missed more than words can say.

Tango fam, we are here for anything you need. 💙

name: Brittany Arndt
message: Tango, thank you for your service to not only protect your city, but your community and family. This world needs more dedicated, loving souls like yours. I'm sure you and your legacy will never be forgotten and live on in your loved ones hearts forever. Rest easy, dear pup.

name: Kyle Bartz
message: Tango, I had the honor of knowing you for several months and you made an indelible mark on my heart. You really are a beautiful soul. I hope to meet you again someday over the Rainbow Bridge. Rest easy and Godspeed.

name: Ken Onken
message: Our hearts are filled with sadness but we know you are no longer in pain. Our sympathies are with your family as well as the Menomonee Falls Police Department and our community.
